summary: After years of stakeholder conversations, the new voluntary certification standard aims to “build trust” in a polarizing industry, SCS Standards says.

title: Century Waste takes over Staten Island waste zone contract via acquisition
summary: The acquisition of Priority First Carting’s assets will allow Century to begin signing up customers in the New York City borough when its commercial waste zone opens on July 1.

title: Waste companies weigh costs — and benefits — of PFAS Superfund rule
summary: As technology spreads, the waste industry is beginning to identify the cost of treating landfill leachate for PFAS. Republic Services and Clean Harbors are already driving revenue from treatment, with bullish growth projections.
